items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Pepper (a little)' to USDA FNDDS 'Peppers, raw, NFS'. The quantity wording does not change the reviewed food label: the corpus already binds both 'Pepper' and '*Pepper' to this exact FDC record, and this target's own pinned evidence contains that same record at rank 9. Confidence remains medium because the English word 'pepper' can also mean peppercorn spice; this approval follows the catalog's already-reviewed vegetable-pepper identity for this exact label family and does not generalize to black or white pepper.

Confidence remains medium because the pepper component and blend ratio are not represented by the salt-only profile.
